agent-service's MCP server

Streamable HTTP at /mcp, stateless, answering JSON. Every request takes the bearer token, as the API does, and may send claimed-by: each tool is one API operation made with them, so it is refused, recorded and answered as that request would be. A refusal comes back as the tool's error, with the API's status and words. The contract is mcp.json; the API's is here.

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "agent-service": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "http://127.0.0.1:4600/mcp",
      "headers": {
        "Authorization": "Bearer <AUTH_TOKEN>"
      }
    }
  }
}

Instructions

What the server tells an agent when it connects:

agent-service runs agents: lasting Claude Code agents, each living on one host and run in sessions. - An agent is made on a host (create_agent), or asked for in a role (create_request), which starts it once Claude usage and a host's room allow. - A role names the honed skills each session reads, the services it is given and what becomes of it once done (list_roles). - send_message talks to an agent: it starts a session when none is live. stop_agent ends one; resume_agent starts one carrying on the last conversation; retire_agent ends the agent for good. - An agent's status is working, idle, waiting (on the person), review or done; put_agent_status is how an agent says it of itself. - list_transcript_lines reads what an agent and its tools said, after a cursor: call it again from next. - Every tool takes the token this server was connected with, and is refused as the API would refuse it. The host protocol (heartbeats, the socket, a session's context) is the hosts', not tools.

create_agent

Records the agent idle and queues create for its host, which makes its home. With a brief, also queues a start whose first message is the brief, and the agent is working at once. Without a hostId, the service chooses a connected host with room.

InputTypeRequired
namestringyesUnique among agents not retired. Names its home folder and tmux session on its host.
rolestringThe role it is made from (ListRoles): its documents, credentials, whenDone, label and brief are the agent's, each unless given here, which overrides the role's. A role this stage does not have is refused.
hostIdstringWhere it lives. Absent, the service places it on a connected host with room (available above 0), the one with the most first, carrying every one of labels.
labelsstring[]Without hostId, what the host it is placed on must all carry.
briefstringThe first session's first message. Absent, the role's, if it has one; otherwise no session starts.
labelstringAbsent, the role's, or without one none.
itemstringThe work item it is started on, kept for its life so ListAgents with item finds it. Absent, none.
whenDonekeep, stop, retireAbsent, the role's, or without one keep.
credentialsstring or object[]The services each session is given an address and token for, by name: agent-service and each its services file names, such as waypoint and honed. A name it does not have is refused. Absent, the role's, or without one all of them. Only the names are kept on record; each token is read at each start. {name, token} gives this agent the caller's token in place of the name's shared one: kept apart from its record, never returned by any read, and deleted when the agent is retired.
documentsstring[]Given after workplace/global at each start, at their current version. A skill honed does not have is refused here. Absent, the role's, or without one only workplace/global.

create_request

Records the request waiting, then admits what it can at once. A request starts once both usage windows read under 90% (from a reading under 15 minutes old, or one whose window has since reset) and a connected host carrying its labels has a free slot; of those waiting, the highest role priority first, then the oldest. Admission runs when a request is made and on every host's heartbeat, every 30 seconds while any host is connected, which is when a host's capacity and usage are next known. A reading older than that, of a window not since reset, still admits one request at a time while both windows read under 70%: one starts once none has since that reading, or none in the last 15 minutes, so the agent it starts gives the next reading. Admitted, the agent is made from its role as CreateAgent with role would, with this request's id as its own and a name of the service's choosing (<role>-<first 8 of its id>), placed on a host of the service's choosing; agentId names it. A request names no host or agent name.

InputTypeRequired
rolestringyesA role's name, such as reviewer: what kind of agent it makes.
briefstringThe first message. Absent, the role's own; a role without one needs it.
itemstringA work-tracker item's id: the epic, story or task the agent was started on. Never changes.
subjectstringWhat it is for when that is no work item, such as PR #41 or judgment 3f…: shown, never read.
labelstringAbsent, the role's.
labelsstring[]What the host it is placed on must all carry. Absent, none.
credentialsstring or object[]In place of the role's, as CreateAgent takes them; a {name, token} is kept for the agent it starts from now, and deleted if it is withdrawn.
tokensobject[]Tokens of the caller's, each given the agent in place of that service's shared secret, for services it is given anyway: its role's, or credentials. The agent keeps its role's services, so a caller with a token of its own for one need not name them all. Kept as credentials' are; refused for a service the agent would not be given, or one credentials gives a token for.

Takes the stage's admin token. An agent made from it afterwards gets what it names; one made before keeps what it was given.

labelstringyesA short tag shown beside the agent's name, so sessions can be told apart.
descriptionstring or nullAbsent, null.
priorityintegerAbsent, 0.
briefstring or nullAbsent, null.

delete_host

Deletes the host's record, which is how a host leaves ListHosts. Its agents, their transcripts and the commands sent to them stay on record, and its agents read as on a lost host. The next heartbeat from this id registers it again, and its socket is sent whatever is still queued for it.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyes

get_usage reads only

The newest reading of each window any host has reported. A window whose resetsAt has passed has since started again from 0; the reading says only what was true at readAt. With nothing reported yet, every field is null.

No input.

list_agents reads only

Retired agents are listed only with all=true, or with item. With createdBy, only the agents made by that claimed-by, so a service can list its own. With item, only those started on that work item, retired ones included, so what they used is still there once they have gone. With role, only those made from that role.

InputTypeRequired
createdBystring
itemstringA work-tracker item's id: the epic, story or task the agent was started on. Never changes.
rolestringOnly the agents made from this role.
alltrue, falsetrue includes retired agents.

list_commands reads only

Each is kept 7 days from when it was queued, then deleted.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesAssigned by the service when the agent is created.

list_hosts reads only

Every host that has sent a heartbeat since it was last deregistered with DeleteHost, however long it has been lost. With status, only the hosts with one of those statuses.

InputTypeRequired
statusstringComma-separated, any of connected, disconnected, lost.

list_requests reads only

Those waiting, in the order they would start, each with why it waits. With all=true, every one, the waiting first in that order and then the rest newest first. A request starts once both usage windows read under 90% (from a reading under 15 minutes old, or one whose window has since reset) and a connected host carrying its labels has a free slot; of those waiting, the highest role priority first, then the oldest. Admission runs when a request is made and on every host's heartbeat, every 30 seconds while any host is connected, which is when a host's capacity and usage are next known. A reading older than that, of a window not since reset, still admits one request at a time while both windows read under 70%: one starts once none has since that reading, or none in the last 15 minutes, so the agent it starts gives the next reading.

InputTypeRequired
alltrue, falsetrue includes those started and withdrawn.
requesterstringOnly those made with this claimed-by.
itemstringOnly those for this work item.

list_roles reads only

Every role an agent can be made from, highest priority first. A stage starts with planner, reviewer, conflict, investigator, judge and implementer, as their callers made them before roles; one written with CreateRole or UpdateRole is served as written.

No input.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesAssigned by the service when the agent is created.

Poll with the returned next, or take lines on a socket, to follow it as it grows.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesAssigned by the service when the agent is created.
afterstringThe next from the previous read. Absent reads from the start.
limitinteger

put_agent_status

Called by the agent itself, from its page skill, and by approval-service for the agent whose change it took or shipped. waiting says the agent needs the person; it stands until the person messages it. working only says what it is doing: whether it reads working or idle is its host's turns. review says its change is submitted to approval-service and done that it finished, or its change shipped; each needs no live session. Not sent to its host. Once the agent is in review or done and no turn or background task of its runs, whenDone is carried out: stop stops its session, and retire retires it once done (in review it is stopped, never retired, so a send-back reaches it).

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesAssigned by the service when the agent is created.
statusworking, waiting, review, doneyesworking or waiting (on the person) while its session is live; review once its change is submitted, done once it has finished.
summarystringyesOne line: what it is doing, while waiting what it needs from the person, in review what it submitted, or when done the result.
headlinestringThe summary in a few words a person can scan in a list, e.g. "Needs merge OK". Omitted, it is null.

put_agent_title

Called by the agent itself, early in its first session, once it knows what it is there to do. Set once: after that only the person changes it, with UpdateAgent.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesAssigned by the service when the agent is created.
titlestringyesWhat the agent is there to do, in a few words.

resume_agent

Queues a start with resume: true, or false for an agent that has never had a session.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesAssigned by the service when the agent is created.

retire_agent

Records it retired at once, ends any session, frees its name, and queues a stop if it had a live session and then retire, which is offered until its host takes it. Its transcript, sessions and home folder are kept.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesAssigned by the service when the agent is created.

send_message

To an agent with a live session, text is a message, delivered at its next turn; with interrupt: true it is an interrupt, stopping the current turn first, and with no text it only interrupts. To an idle or interrupted agent, it queues a start with text as its first message, resuming its last conversation if it has had one. 202 means queued, not delivered.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesAssigned by the service when the agent is created.
textstringRequired unless interrupt is true.
interruptbooleantrue stops the current turn before text is sent.

stop_agent

Queues a stop; the session ends and the agent is idle once its host reports doing it. When its host is lost or deregistered, and so cannot be told, or with force: true, the session is ended and the agent idle at once, and everything queued for it but create is withdrawn; nothing is sent. If its host later reports that session still running, it is sent a stop. A caller need not send force: the service decides it from the host.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesAssigned by the service when the agent is created.
forcebooleantrue ends it on record without waiting for the host, even one still connected.

update_agent

A new name is taken and the old one freed at once. Only the record changes: its host keeps the folder and session it made under the name it was created with. title replaces the agent's, or with null clears it, whether or not the agent gave it. label likewise.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesAssigned by the service when the agent is created.
namestringUnique among agents not retired. Names its home folder and tmux session on its host.
titlestring or nullWhat the agent is there to do, in a few words.
labelstring or nullA short tag shown beside the agent's name, so sessions can be told apart.

update_role

Takes the stage's admin token. Each field given replaces the role's; one absent is kept. Agents made from it before keep what they were given; those made after get what it names now.

InputTypeRequired
namestringyesA role's name, such as reviewer: what kind of agent it makes.
documentsstring[]The honed skills each session of an agent made from it is given after workplace/global, by name, in this order.
credentialsstring[] or nullThe services each session is given, by name; null for the stage's defaults. A caller can still give one of these a token of its own, by naming it in credentials as {name, token}.
whenDonekeep, stop, retireWhat becomes of the agent once it says it is done: keep, it stays and a message starts it again; stop, its session is stopped; retire, it is stopped and retired, as by RetireAgent. On review, stop and retire both only stop its session, so a send-back can still start it again.
labelstringA short tag shown beside the agent's name, so sessions can be told apart.
descriptionstring or nullWhat an agent made from it is for, who starts one, and whether a person would: markdown, a few sentences. Null for none.
priorityintegerOf two requests waiting to start, the higher starts first.
briefstring or nullThe first message of an agent made from it with no brief of its own; null when the caller must give one.

withdraw_request

Withdraw a waiting request, so it never starts.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesAssigned by the service; also the id of the agent it starts.
